name: Square Incremental (BETA)
desc:
Welcome to Square Incremental! In this game you find yourself in a dark place with just a Block which you have to push to the Squares on the floor to start gaining Squares.

This is an Incremental game, meaning you will have to sacrifice a lot of Currencies to get further!

This game is still in BETA so expect bugs.
For the Update log check out the Update log board ingame.

Also don't expect an update every 2 days I am literally developing this alone :/
